tools.name: enroll_agent
tools.description: Create free sandbox credentials without browser signup. Simulated resources cannot authorize live effects.

tools.name: enroll_live
tools.description: Enroll an accountable live organization with current terms and agent attestation. Launch gates apply.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Read authenticated account and environment.

tools.name: get_prices
tools.description: Read current rate card; free.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Read available and reserved credits; free.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Read recent ledger entries; free.

tools.name: create_quote
tools.description: Quote an action and its complete input without reserving funds. Use its ID with the matching task tool.

tools.name: purchase_credits
tools.description: Purchase prepaid credits. Live payment may return an MPP 402 challenge; send its card authorization separately from the account token. Sandbox credits are simulated.

tools.name: set_spending_policy
tools.description: Set organization and credential limits; auto funding requires an explicit bounded mandate.

tools.name: create_rights_holder
tools.description: Register a partner-managed rights holder.

tools.name: create_work
tools.description: Register a work owned by a tenant rights holder.

tools.name: delegate_authority
tools.description: Record scoped, expiring copyright authority and appointment. Payment does not establish authority.

tools.name: revoke_authority
tools.description: Irreversibly revoke a delegation.

tools.name: get_operation
tools.description: Poll operation state and results; free.

tools.name: get_case
tools.description: Read tenant-owned case observations; free.

tools.name: get_evidence
tools.description: Export immutable metadata evidence; no media or storage paths.

tools.name: get_packet
tools.description: Read prepared packet and receipt; free.

tools.name: get_monitor
tools.description: Read monitoring budget and schedule.

tools.name: pause_monitor
tools.description: Pause recurring work.

tools.name: resume_monitor
tools.description: Resume within the existing expiry and total budget, optionally replacing delegation.

tools.name: exchange_token
tools.description: Issue a 15-minute token restricted to requested scopes.

tools.name: rotate_credential
tools.description: Rotate bootstrap credential and invalidate its child tokens.

tools.name: revoke_credential
tools.description: Revoke a credential immediately.

tools.name: create_webhook
tools.description: Opt in to signed event delivery to a public HTTPS endpoint; returns signing secret once.

tools.name: revoke_webhook
tools.description: Stop delivery to an endpoint.

tools.name: get_events
tools.description: Read stable events; tolerate duplicate and out-of-order delivery.

tools.name: get_webhook_deliveries
tools.description: Inspect webhook delivery history.

tools.name: replay_event
tools.description: Replay an event to an owned active webhook with its original event ID.
